name: Le Nonne (Logan, UT) Handcrafted Potato Gnocchi in Butter & Parmigiano
whyItWorks: Logan's fine dining Italian gem! Pillowy handcrafted potato dumplings gently simmered and tossed in browned butter and aged Parmigiano Reggiano. Aged parmesan is naturally lactose-free.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Potato Gnocchi with butter and parmesan cheese (hold rich gorgonzola or heavy garlic sauces).
